name: v0.30.2 - FalkorDB updates
body:
## What's Changed
* fix(ci): bump gh-action-pypi-publish for metadata 2.5 by @prasmussen15 in https://github.com/getzep/graphiti/pull/1821
* Bump graphiti-core to 0.30.1 by @prasmussen15 in https://github.com/getzep/graphiti/pull/1822
* Fix Neo4j database routing and honor NEO4J_DATABASE in MCP server by @mehulp93 in https://github.com/getzep/graphiti/pull/1812
* fix: include Saga nodes when clearing data by group_ids by @Naseem77 in https://github.com/getzep/graphiti/pull/1688
* fix: bind arguments by name in multi-group decorator branch (#1758) by @icn5381 in https://github.com/getzep/graphiti/pull/1760
* fix: use request-scoped driver for concurrent multi-group_id isolation (#1676) by @ozdemirsarman in https://github.com/getzep/graphiti/pull/1699
* fix(falkordb): avoid a full :Entity scan per hit in edge_fulltext_search by @trevor-sykes in https://github.com/getzep/graphiti/pull/1711
* Land contributor fixes from #1686 #1689 #1720 #1761 by @prasmussen15 in https://github.com/getzep/graphiti/pull/1856
* Bump graphiti-core to 0.30.2 by @prasmussen15 in https://github.com/getzep/graphiti/pull/1858

## New Contributors
* @icn5381 made their first contribution in https://github.com/getzep/graphiti/pull/1760
* @ozdemirsarman made their first contribution in https://github.com/getzep/graphiti/pull/1699
* @trevor-sykes made their first contribution in https://github.com/getzep/graphiti/pull/1711

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/getzep/graphiti/compare/v0.30.0...v0.30.2
